StoryData/P10117.json#52#content.zh: 故而我决意监管百货中一切皮革加工事务。
StoryData/P10117.json#52#content.en: Thus I have decided to oversee all matters of leatherworking in the Grand Magasin.

StoryData/P10117.json#53#content.zh: 但我并非不知变通，例外总是可以有的。<size=150%>有</size><size=150%>价</size>值<size=150%>且</size><size=150%>理</size>想<size=150%>懂</size>得<size=150%>其</size><size=150%>价</size>值<size=150%>者</size><size=150%>必</size><size=150%>将</size><size=150%>于</size><size=150%>最</size><size=150%>理</size>想<size=150%>之</size><size=150%>交</size>易<size=150%>中</size><size=150%>获</size>得<size=150%>物</size>有所值。
StoryData/P10117.json#53#content.en: Yet I shan't be inflexible, and exceptions may always be made. <size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>W</size>ORTHY<size=150%>A</size>ND<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>I</size>DEAL<size=150%>W</size>HO<size=150%>K</size>NOW<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>W</size>ORTH<size=150%>S</size>HALL<size=150%>G</size>ET<size=150%>T</size>HEIR<size=150%>E</size>YEBALLS'<size=150%>W</size>ORTH<size=150%>I</size>N<size=150%>D</size>EALS<size=150%>M</size>OST<size=150%>I</size>DEAL.

StoryData/P10117.json#54#content.zh: 可惜，关于那些例外，你永远只能知道那块削薄的皮革碎料值多少——而你出于私心将其如此贬低，甚至想分文不付就据为己有。
StoryData/P10117.json#54#content.en: Alas, you shan't ever know more of what lies in those exceptions than the worth of the skived scrap leather, which you have undervalued so self-servingly that you would fain make it yours at no cost.

StoryData/P10117.json#55#content.zh: ……而你怀揣着何等珍贵的宝物啊。我要将它据为己有，拥入我那注视之翼下……！
StoryData/P10117.json#55#content.en: ... And what precious treasure you harbor. I shall make it mine and embrace it under my seeing wings...!

StoryData/P10117.json#57#content.zh: 他、他注意到我的黄金皮革了！

StoryData/P10117.json#58#content.zh: 就好像他体内有什么开关被拨动了。
StoryData/P10117.json#58#content.en: It was as though something had flipped a switch inside him.

StoryData/P10117.json#59#content.zh: 楼层经理毫无征兆地撑开了伞，十几个东西从折叠在伞膜内那不可能存在的空间里跃出，挥舞着手臂想要抓我、挠我。
StoryData/P10117.json#59#content.en: Out of the blue, the Floor Manager unfurled his umbrella, and a dozen things leaped out from the impossible space folded within its membranes, flailing their arms to grab and scratch me.

StoryData/P10117.json#60#content.zh: 更糟的是，这层楼的其他住户也开始齐刷刷地朝我拖步、爬行而来，像是想赶在楼层经理把它们也像皮革手套那样关起来之前讨好他。
StoryData/P10117.json#60#content.en: To make matters worse, the other inhabitants of the floor began to shuffle and crawl toward me in unison, as though trying to ingratiate themselves with the Floor Manager before he could incarcerate them like the Leather Glove.

StoryData/P10117.json#61#content.zh: 或许我能好好利用一下这个局面，我心想。
StoryData/P10117.json#61#content.en: Perhaps I could make the best out of this situation, I thought.

StoryData/P10117.json#62#content.zh: 我的“作品”终于开始成形，之前在楼上B2F用的时候，它也绰绰有余地派上了用场。
StoryData/P10117.json#62#content.en: My "piece" was finally starting to take shape, and it more than carried its weight when I put it to use earlier upstairs on B2F.

StoryData/P10117.json#65#content.zh: 啊……早知道就该用金属别针固定的！它一下子应付不了这么多的敌人……
StoryData/P10117.json#65#content.en: Agh... I knew I should've used metal pins to fix them! It can't handle such an overwhelming number of enemies all at once...

StoryData/P10117.json#66#content.zh: 是它还太不完整了？还是敌人实在太多，它应付不过来？不管是哪个原因，我都只能火速撤退了。
StoryData/P10117.json#66#content.en: Was it still too incomplete? Were there simply too many enemies for it to handle? Whichever was the reason, I had no choice but to make an expeditious retreat.

StoryData/P10117.json#67#content.zh: A1……C7……E21……我一路往B3F深处跑去，写着字母与数字的柱子从我身边飞掠而过。
StoryData/P10117.json#67#content.en: A1... C7... E21... I run deeper and deeper into B3F, pillars with letters and numbers whizzing by me.

StoryData/P10117.json#68#content.zh: 怎么办，怎么办？我的作品还能再用一次，可我不可能把它们全都解决……
StoryData/P10117.json#68#content.en: What do I do, what do I do? I can get one more use out of my piece, but there's no way I can take all of them...

StoryData/P10117.json#70#content.zh: 我在柱子间拼命狂奔，只停下来片刻喘口气、稳住身子。就在那时，我感觉到了——有什么东西仿佛握住了我的手，一股突如其来的温暖……一道光。
StoryData/P10117.json#70#content.en: I was dashing madly through the pillars, pausing just long enough to catch my breath and steady myself. And that's when I felt it—something that seemed to almost clasp my hand, a sudden warmth... a ray of light.

StoryData/P10117.json#71#content.zh: 一个我不认识的符号，从内部被同样温暖的光芒填满。
StoryData/P10117.json#71#content.en: A symbol I didn't recognize, filling from within with that same warm light.

StoryData/P10117.json#72#content.zh: ……我得出结论，这可以视作人类的命运。
StoryData/P10117.json#72#content.en: ... I concluded that this could be regarded as human fate.

StoryData/P10117.json#73#content.zh: 在那里，我发现了某人的……文字。大概和我在其他楼层看到的是同一系列的笔记——那些笔记似乎记载着外界的故事。
StoryData/P10117.json#73#content.en: There, I found someone's... writing. It was, presumably, a part of the same series of notes I'd seen on the other floors—notes that seemed to carry tales of the world outside.

StoryData/P10117.json#74#content.zh: 和在其他楼层时一样，我仍然不明白它是什么意思，但这些东西总有某种地方一直挠着我的脑子……
StoryData/P10117.json#74#content.en: I still had as little idea what it meant as I did on the other floors, but there's something about these that keeps tickling my brain...

StoryData/P10117.json#75#content.zh: ……而某种巧合之下，那个结构呈现出了树的形状。
StoryData/P10117.json#75#content.en: ... And by some stroke of coincidence, that structure took the shape of a tree.

StoryData/P10117.json#77#content.zh: 巨人们都已经知道接下来会发生什么了。我们也会持续监测你的状态。但是……
StoryData/P10117.json#77#content.en: The Giants have all been informed of what's going to happen. And we'll be constantly monitoring your status, too. But...

StoryData/P10117.json#78#content.zh: ……为什么你就不能至少把记忆留下呢？
StoryData/P10117.json#78#content.en: ... why can't you at least let the memories stay?

StoryData/P10117.json#79#content.zh: 如果记忆延续下去，用不了多久心智就会衰老过头。
StoryData/P10117.json#79#content.en: If the memories carry over, it won't be long before the mind ages too much.

StoryData/P10117.json#80#content.zh: 这我不否认，可是……听着，这样一来就什么都不会留下了。
StoryData/P10117.json#80#content.en: I won't deny that, but... Look, there won't be anything left like this.

StoryData/P10117.json#81#content.en: Are you sure you're okay with this?

StoryData/P10117.json#82#content.zh: 我已经想通了。即便记忆几乎全都褪去……
StoryData/P10117.json#82#content.en: I've made my peace. Even when the memories have all but faded...

StoryData/P10117.json#85#content.zh: 有什么东西流进了我的身体。那是什么？记忆？经验？
StoryData/P10117.json#85#content.en: Something flowed into me. What was that? Memory? Experience?

StoryData/P10117.json#86#content.zh: 如果都不是……那是情感吗？
StoryData/P10117.json#86#content.en: And if neither... Is it emotion?

StoryData/P10117.json#87#content.zh: 这些是我过去某个时候的想法吗？
StoryData/P10117.json#87#content.en: Are these my own thoughts from times past?

StoryData/P10117.json#88#content.zh: 如果是，那是什么时候？在哪里……？
StoryData/P10117.json#88#content.en: If so, from when? From where...?

StoryData/P10117.json#91#content.zh: 经验会留下，是吗……嗯，那我能接受。
StoryData/P10117.json#91#content.en: The experience remains, huh... Yeah, I can live with that.

StoryData/P10117.json#92#content.en: Focus on the experience of my present.

StoryData/P10117.json#93#content.zh: 也就是说……要鼓起勇气去经历正面迎战那位楼层经理这件事，哪怕这意味着要把我自己的杰作拆得粉碎。
StoryData/P10117.json#93#content.en: Which means... braving the experience of facing that Floor Manager head-on, even if it means breaking my own masterpiece into pieces.

StoryData/P10117.json#94#content.zh: 它的形态会失去、会破碎，但只要经验还在……我就能把它复原。
StoryData/P10117.json#94#content.en: Its form will be lost and shattered, but as long as the experiences remain... I can restore it.

StoryData/P10117.json#95#content.zh: 哦哦，这怪人坚持住了。<size=150%>迷</size>人<size=150%>可</size>逆<size=150%>反</size>应。
StoryData/P10117.json#95#content.en: Ohh, the oddity stands his ground. <size=150%>F</size>ASCINATING<size=150%>R</size>EVERSIBLE<size=150%>R</size>EACTION.

StoryData/P10117.json#96#content.zh: 直到这时，我才终于意识到……
StoryData/P10117.json#96#content.en: Only then did I finally realize...

StoryData/P10117.json#98#content.zh: ……我的作品已经多么接近完成了。
StoryData/P10117.json#98#content.en: ... just how close to completion my piece had become.

StoryData/P11217.json#1#content.zh: 这么说，你见过这件寿衣。我没说错吧？
StoryData/P11217.json#1#content.en: So you've seen this shroud before. Have I got that right?

StoryData/P11217.json#2#content.zh: 我在B2F见到的那位楼层经理，是个悠闲随和的……“人”。至少我是这么觉得的。
StoryData/P11217.json#2#content.en: The Floor Manager I met down on B2F was a relaxed, easygoing... "person." That was the impression I got, anyway.

StoryData/P11217.json#3#content.zh: 他身上隐约带着一股陈旧的烟味，本该是一条手臂的地方，长着个丑陋的东西，看起来活像是昆虫的腿。我确实有点被吓到，但按西西弗百货的标准来看？我觉得应该没问题。
StoryData/P11217.json#3#content.en: He smelled faintly of stale cigarette smoke, and where one arm should've been, he had this ugly thing that looked an awful lot like an insect's leg. It put me off a little, sure, but by Grand Magasin standards? I figured I'd be fine.

StoryData/P11217.json#4#content.en: Uh, yeah... I'm pretty sure I have.

StoryData/P11217.json#5#content.zh: 好，好。这下我就放心了……这说明那位还穿着我为那位做的寿衣。
StoryData/P11217.json#5#content.en: Good, good. That's a weight off my mind... It means He still wears the shroud I made for Him.

StoryData/P11217.json#6#content.zh: 等等，那是你做的？真奇怪……我记得他们说线团之巢一整个季度都只纺线来着。
StoryData/P11217.json#6#content.en: Wait, you made it? That's funny... I could've sworn they said the Skein Nest spins nothing but thread all season.

StoryData/P11217.json#7#content.zh: 其实我就是为这个来的。想要些线来缝我的作品……
StoryData/P11217.json#7#content.en: That's what I came for, actually. Some thread to sew my piece together...

StoryData/P11217.json#8#content.zh: 别担心，你来对地方了。告诉你这话的人也没说错。几个季度以前，这地方全靠纺线这门生意转着。
StoryData/P11217.json#8#content.en: Don't you worry, you've come to the right place. And whoever told you that had it right, too. A few seasons back, thread was the whole business that made this place go 'round.

StoryData/P11217.json#9#content.zh: 我现在就可以接你的单……那么。你想要什么？
StoryData/P11217.json#9#content.en: Nothing stopping me from taking your order right now... So. What is it you want?

StoryData/P11217.json#10#content.zh: 关于他，我还听说了另一件事。
StoryData/P11217.json#10#content.en: I'd heard something else about him, too.

StoryData/P11217.json#11#content.zh: 据说B2F的楼层经理纺线不另收费。如果说他要什么回报的话……
StoryData/P11217.json#11#content.en: Word was the B2F Floor Manager didn't charge a separate fee for spinning. If there was anything he asked in return...

StoryData/P11217.json#12#content.zh: 我只要告诉你我有多想要这些线，对吧？
StoryData/P11217.json#12#content.en: I just have to tell you how badly I want the thread, right?

StoryData/P11217.json#13#content.zh: *呼* 传言这东西真是招人喜欢。它自己就在西西弗百货里四处传开了，我连这个房间的门都不用迈出去一步。
StoryData/P11217.json#13#content.en: *puff* You've gotta love a rumor. Off it goes on its rounds of the Grand Magasin, and I don't so much as have to put a foot outside this room.

StoryData/P11217.json#14#content.zh: 省得我跑腿了。我还得转纺车呢，要是还得四处跟人解释我们这儿怎么做事，那可有点麻烦……
StoryData/P11217.json#14#content.en: Saves me the legwork. Bit of a nuisance, having to go around explaining how we work when I've got a wheel to turn...

StoryData/P11217.json#15#content.zh: ……呃，所以我现在该开口了吗，还是……？
StoryData/P11217.json#15#content.en: ... Um, so am I supposed to start talking now, or...?

StoryData/P11217.json#16#content.zh: 嗯？哦，抱歉。一直都是我在说，是吧？
StoryData/P11217.json#16#content.en: Hm? Oh, my bad. Been doing all the talking myself, haven't I?

StoryData/P11217.json#18#content.zh: 你现在渴望的，是这件寿衣的真相，对吧？瞧你眼睛亮的。
StoryData/P11217.json#18#content.en: What you're yearning for right now is the truth about this shroud, isn't it? Look at how your eyes light up.

StoryData/P11217.json#20#content.zh: 哈。看来我到底是怎么纺线的，这事还没传开？
StoryData/P11217.json#20#content.en: Huh. I take it word hasn't gotten around about how I actually spin the stuff?

StoryData/P11217.json#21#content.zh: 传言就这点可惜。它们能钻进每个角落缝隙，可除此之外就没多少实在东西了。拿一条一路传到这底下的传言来纺，纺出来的东西你都不好意思管它叫线。
StoryData/P11217.json#21#content.en: That's the pity about rumors. They get into every nook and cranny, but don't bring much substance beyond that. Try spinning one that makes it all the way down here, and you'd be too ashamed to even call the result thread.

StoryData/P11217.json#22#content.zh: 所以给我讲个真故事吧——货真价实的那种，你知道的，满得往外溢的渴望与向往在里头翻腾！那种想要得不得了，要是得不到，宁可拧断自己脖子的东西……！
StoryData/P11217.json#22#content.en: So gimme a real story—the real deal, y'know, squirming with so much want and yearning that it spills over! Something you desire so badly you'd sooner wring your own neck than go without it...!

StoryData/P11217.json#23#content.zh: ……那样才能纺出结实的线。还有它的光泽也是。
StoryData/P11217.json#23#content.en: ... That's how you get thread that'll hold. And the shine of it, too.

StoryData/P11217.json#24#content.zh: ……我想我得把之前印象里“悠闲随和”那部分划掉了。
StoryData/P11217.json#24#content.en: ... Think I'll scratch out the "relaxed and easygoing" part from my earlier impression.

StoryData/P11217.json#25#content.zh: 他一点点凑近，每迈一步、每吐一个字，话语都更加沉重。他靠得越近，眼中那股癫狂野性的光芒就越明显，一点点地剥蚀着我。
StoryData/P11217.json#25#content.en: He inched closer, increasing the weight of his words with each step and subsequent syllable. And the closer he got, the more apparent the mad, wild gleam in his eyes became, picking away at me.

StoryData/P11217.json#26#content.zh: 换作几个季度以前，光这样就足以把我吓得原路逃回去了。但是……
StoryData/P11217.json#26#content.en: A few seasons ago, that would've been enough to send me scurrying scared back the way I'd come. But...

StoryData/P11217.json#27#content.zh: ……你说得对。我对自己的作品确实怀有那种渴望，但不止如此。
StoryData/P11217.json#27#content.en: ... You're right. I do feel that kind of yearning about my work, but there's more to it.

StoryData/P11217.json#28#content.zh: 你看，我就是放不下我的好奇心。我想知道你是怎么认识那个……现在被称为赤红之神的人的。还有，一个只纺过线的人，怎么会做出一件真正的衣服。
StoryData/P11217.json#28#content.en: You see, I can't just leave my curiosity alone. I wanna know how you know that... person they call the Crimson God now. And how somebody who only ever spun thread came to make an actual garment.

StoryData/P11217.json#29#content.zh: 你看，这正是我在做的东西的意义所在。每当我找到某个疑问的答案，我就会做一个体现所学的配件，挂到作品上。我想，作品就是这么拼起来的。一个配件一个配件地，添上每一份美德。
StoryData/P11217.json#29#content.en: See, that's the whole point of what I'm making. Whenever I find the answer to something I've wondered about, I make a fitting that shows what I learned and attach it to the piece. That's how it comes together, I guess. Each virtue added, one fitting at a time.

StoryData/P11217.json#30#content.zh: 所以这也是一件……我真的很需要你回答的事。
StoryData/P11217.json#30#content.en: So this is one more thing... I really need you to answer.

StoryData/P11217.json#31#content.zh: ……他低声笑了笑，凑了过来，直到他的脸紧贴着我的脸。
StoryData/P11217.json#31#content.en: ... He gave a low chuckle and leaned in until his face was right up against mine.

StoryData/P11217.json#34#content.zh: 你的那份渴望……我会给你纺一条双股线。很好。非常好……
StoryData/P11217.json#34#content.en: That yearning of yours... I'll be spinning you a two-ply thread. That's good. Very good...

StoryData/P11217.json#35#content.zh: 也就是说，两股线拧在一起……拧两次？
StoryData/P11217.json#35#content.en: So, two strands, twisted together... twice?

StoryData/P11217.json#36#content.zh: 怎么，你做的东西需要单股吗？不……我看不需要。
StoryData/P11217.json#36#content.en: Why, did you need single-ply for whatever you're making? Nah... I don't think you do.

StoryData/P11217.json#37#content.zh: 照我看，你心里的渴望不止一个。不过随便顺着哪一个往回找，最后都归结到同一件大事上——你想把你一直在拼的那件衣服做完。
StoryData/P11217.json#37#content.en: Far as I can tell, you've got more than one yearning in you. Follow any one of 'em back, though, and it all comes down to the one big thing—you wanna finish that garment you've been putting together.

StoryData/P11217.json#38#content.zh: 你的好奇心就是从那儿来的，对吧？那么……你这件还没完成的作品，至少得用双股线。要是我说得离谱了，就告诉我。
StoryData/P11217.json#38#content.en: That's where this curiosity of yours stems from, isn't it? Well, then... this in-progress work of yours calls for two-ply at the very least. Tell me if I'm wide of the mark.

StoryData/P11217.json#39#content.zh: 其实我本来也想问问你关于这些的建议……
StoryData/P11217.json#39#content.en: Actually, I was going to ask your advice about all that, too...

StoryData/P11217.json#40#content.zh: 不过听你这么一说，我明白那种线为什么适合我在做的东西了。
StoryData/P11217.json#40#content.en: But hearing you talk, I can see how that kind of thread would suit what I'm making.

StoryData/P11217.json#41#content.zh: 我想，那终究就是我想要的吧。可以说是我自己的欲望。
StoryData/P11217.json#41#content.en: I guess that was what I wanted, after all. A desire of my own, you might say.

StoryData/P11217.json#43#content.zh: 以前我就坐在这巢里，纺着线，听着送到我这儿来的各种故事。也就这么些事。
StoryData/P11217.json#43#content.en: Used to be I'd sit here in my nest, spinning thread and listening to whatever stories came my way. Not much else to it.

StoryData/P11217.json#44#content.zh: 我有命运之声一路指点我。从哪儿开始，该怎么做，该纺什么线……总在那儿告诉我下一次该纺什么。
StoryData/P11217.json#44#content.en: I had the Voice of Fate talking me through it. Where to start, how to go about it, the thread to spin... always there to tell me what I ought to spin next.

StoryData/P11217.json#45#content.zh: 说真的，没什么可抱怨的。

StoryData/P11217.json#46#content.zh: 可是，我按部就班做着这些的时候，一直觉得缺了点什么。
StoryData/P11217.json#46#content.en: Still, I felt like I was missing something the whole time I went through the motions.

StoryData/P11217.json#47#content.zh: 我是说，线是用来干什么的？穿进针里，用它缝点东西。或者把线织在一起做成布。对吧？
StoryData/P11217.json#47#content.en: I mean, what're threads for? You put one through a needle and stitch something with it. Or you weave them together and make cloth. Right?

StoryData/P11217.json#48#content.zh: 只不过，命运之声给我安排的不是这个。从来都不是。有些日子，我会发现自己盼着听到一句“今天织点布吧”，可那样的启示从来没降临到我身上过。
StoryData/P11217.json#48#content.en: Only, that's not what the Voice of Fate had in store for me. Never did. Some days I'd catch myself hoping to hear, "Make some cloth today," but no revelation like that ever came my way.

StoryData/P11217.json#49#content.zh: 后来有一天……我遇见了那位。
StoryData/P11217.json#49#content.en: Then one day... I met Him.

StoryData/P11217.json#50#content.zh: 那位屈尊一路来到了这底下。
StoryData/P11217.json#50#content.en: He who deigned to come all the way down here.

StoryData/P11217.json#52#content.zh: 你真该看看我用那位的渴望纺出来的线。光彩夺目。闪闪发亮……纯金一般。
StoryData/P11217.json#52#content.en: You should've seen the thread I spun from His yearning. It was radiant. It shone... pure gold.

StoryData/P11217.json#53#content.zh: 我心里有什么东西燃了起来。我可从没有过那种感觉。我忍不住问自己：要是用那条线做出一套真正的衣服，该会是何等狂喜啊？！
StoryData/P11217.json#53#content.en: Something caught fire in me. Never felt anything like it, mind you. I couldn't help but ask myself the question: just how ecstatic would it be to make an actual outfit out of that thread?!

StoryData/P11217.json#54#content.zh: 就在那时，那位对我开口了。
StoryData/P11217.json#54#content.en: And that's when He spoke to me.

StoryData/P11217.json#55#content.zh: “任由欲望行事吧。追随你的欲望……”
StoryData/P11217.json#55#content.en: "Let desire have its way. Follow your desires..."

StoryData/P11217.json#56#content.zh: “……照你所渴望的去做，”那位这么说。那位说，当想要摄取的冲动找上门来，我们就该任由它行事。
StoryData/P11217.json#56#content.en: "... and do as you have yearned," he said. He said that when the urge to consume comes calling, we're to let it have its way.

StoryData/P11217.json#57#content.zh: 还说，不管做出了什么，那位都非常想穿上。
StoryData/P11217.json#57#content.en: And that he'd very much like to wear whatever came of it.

StoryData/P11217.json#58#content.zh: 原来你就是因为这个才投靠了红派。
StoryData/P11217.json#58#content.en: So that's what brought you over to Le Rouge.

StoryData/P11217.json#59#content.zh: 差不多就是这么回事。黑派那帮人一直是我店里的老主顾，可他们的漆黑之神……？我说不出这百货店里有哪样东西是他想要的。
StoryData/P11217.json#59#content.en: That's about the size of it. Them Le Noir folks've been longtime customers of my shop, but their Obsidian God...? I couldn't name one thing in this department store he wants.

StoryData/P11217.json#60#content.zh: 我可以随便动手，想做什么就做什么，而他只会……接受它的存在。说真的，仅此而已。一个像局外人一样的神，你懂我意思吧。追随一个真正想要这些货的人，总不能怪我吧？
StoryData/P11217.json#60#content.en: I could turn my hand to anything, make whatever I liked, and he'd just... accept that it exists. Seriously, no more to it than that. A god who comes across like a stranger, if you catch my drift. Can't blame a fella for following somebody who actually wants the goods, can you?

StoryData/P11217.json#61#content.zh: 我时不时还会再做一件黄金寿衣，跟那天做的那件一样。算是我纪念那一天的方式。我想着哪天给那位送件新寿衣也不错，毕竟那位现在穿的那件也快褪色了。瞧瞧这光泽……
StoryData/P11217.json#61#content.en: Now and then I'll run up another Golden Shroud, same as the one I made that day. My way of marking the occasion. Thought it'd be nice to give Him a new shroud one day, seeing as the one He's got is due to start fading. Look at the shine on this...

StoryData/P11217.json#62#content.zh: ……哦？原来你的渴望得到回应时，眼睛里会是这种神情啊。
StoryData/P11217.json#62#content.en: ... Oh? So that's the look you get in your eyes when your yearning's been met, huh.

StoryData/P11217.json#63#content.zh: 很好。够我用的了。看来我该去转纺车了。
StoryData/P11217.json#63#content.en: Good. Plenty there for me to work with. Suppose it's time for me to get wheeling, then.

StoryData/P11217.json#64#content.zh: 关于我想要的线，我还一个字都没跟他说过。可当他走向纺车时，我也没有拦住他提出我的要求。
StoryData/P11217.json#64#content.en: I hadn't told him the first thing about the thread I wanted. Still, when he headed for his wheel, I didn't hold him back to make my request.

StoryData/P11217.json#65#content.zh: 说他“古怪”都算轻的了，但出于某种同样古怪的理由，我觉得他知道一些我所渴望的东西，是连我自己都还没弄明白的。
StoryData/P11217.json#65#content.en: "Eccentric" would be an understatement, but for some equally odd reason, I had the feeling he knew things about what I yearned for that even I hadn't figured out myself yet.

StoryData/P11217.json#66#content.zh: 好了，那么……再多跟我讲讲你的渴望吧。接下来我要开始把线股拧到一起了。
StoryData/P11217.json#66#content.en: Now, then... Tell me a bit more about that yearning of yours. This is the part where I start twisting the strands together.

StoryData/P11217.json#67#content.zh: 还有，呃，对了——趁这时候，我有件事想请你帮忙。
StoryData/P11217.json#67#content.en: And, uh, right—there's favor I'd like to ask while you're at it.

StoryData/P11217.json#69#content.zh: 古老之物。要是听到纺车在转，它们肯定很快就会冒出来妨碍我干活。
StoryData/P11217.json#69#content.en: Things of eld. They're definitely gonna turn up to hinder my work soon if they hear the wheel spinning.

StoryData/P11217.json#70#content.zh: 明白了。那我最好帮你一把。
StoryData/P11217.json#70#content.en: Got it. I'd better lend a hand, then.

StoryData/P11217.json#71#content.zh: 我想这样一来，我也能更好地展示我的渴望。
StoryData/P11217.json#71#content.en: I think that way, I can showcase my yearning better.

StoryData/P11217.json#73#content.zh: ……*口哨* 瞧瞧这个！这可真是个了不起的“作品”啊！
StoryData/P11217.json#73#content.en: ... *whistle* Would you look at that! Now that's one heck of a "piece" indeed!

StoryData/P11217.json#74#content.zh: 继续！全都讲给我听。不用为了我停下砍它们的手。全都放出来吧！
StoryData/P11217.json#74#content.en: Keep going! Tell me all about it. No need to stop cutting them down on my account. Let all of it loose!

StoryData/P11217.json#75#content.zh: 让我看看那份激情，那份欲望……那渴望之火。
StoryData/P11217.json#75#content.en: Show me that passion, that desire... the fire of the yearning.

StoryData/P11217.json#76#content.zh: 嗯，好的。这有点难为情，不过……我想该正式介绍一下了。
StoryData/P11217.json#76#content.en: Um, okay. This is a little embarrassing, but... I guess a proper introduction is in order.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
以伞膜遮挡阳光乃我等之禁忌，以免有人将雨伞之职责误认作阳伞之职责。
<size=150%>要</size>求<size=150%>克</size>制<size=150%>擅</size>自<size=150%>独</size>行<size=150%>之</size>举。

Forbidden are we to take refuge from the sun 'neath the membrane of an umbrella, lest one mistake the duties of the rainshade for those of a sunshade.
<size=150%>I</size>NSTRUCTING<size=150%>R</size>EFRAINMENT<size=150%>F</size>ROM<size=150%>I</size>NDEPENDENT<size=150%>T</size>OILS.

来者何其怪异反常，须知滚落此处之物，从不借助扶梯。
莫非你的来处，亦是一片更为怪异的异乡？
<size=150%>进</size>行<size=150%>异</size>质<size=150%>存</size>在<size=150%>之</size><size=150%>空</size>间<size=150%>踪</size>迹<size=150%>追</size>溯<size=150%>分</size>析。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
In comes a being so odd and anomalous, for those who tumble down to this place do not avail themselves of the escalator.
Could it be that whence you came, too, is a land of stranger oddities?
<size=150%>C</size>ONDUCTING<size=150%>S</size>PATIAL<size=150%>S</size>HADOWTRACE<size=150%>A</size>NALYSIS<size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>O</size>DDITY<size=150%>E</size>NTITY.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
端详这理想的皮革，不禁令人思索：这抹被阳光晒出的斑斓铜锈之美从何而来？其过程看似如此闲散，不过是皮革在一方明亮光斑中慵懒躺卧罢了。
可叹，阳光自初次渗入以来，从未有一刻甘于隐遁；故而只要百货尚得保存，这皮革便永不会背离理想。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
Taking in this ideal leather, one wonders: how did this beauty tinged in sundry hues of sun-dried patina come to be, for so idle a process it seems when the leather lounges lazily upon the pinch of a well-lit patch?
Alas, never once did the sunshine submit to elusiveness since its first infiltration; thus the hide shall know no departure from the ideal, for as long as the Grand Magasin remains under preservation.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
若你是带着疑问来到我面前，我劝你唇上只着沉默，原路返回。纵使任好奇无解是一桩悲剧，但如此执意在营业时间之后交谈，将受禁令处置。
<size=150%>首</size>次<size=150%>警</size>告<size=150%>记</size>录。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
If you have come before me bearing queries, I urge you to wear only silence upon your lips and return to whence you came. Though it be a tragedy to leave curiosity unanswered, such insistence on communicating past business hours shall be subject to proscription.
<size=150%>F</size>IRST<size=150%>S</size>TRIKE<size=150%>R</size>ECORDED.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
思绪孕育思绪、思绪再孕育思绪，这是唯有与阳光对答、达成相互理解之人才享有的特权；现实的自然流向便是，绝大多数人台都欠缺这份以因果之线将思绪与思绪系连、成为理性沉思的才能。
排队等着鞣制的囚犯们亦是同类；故而我劝你——将那泉涌般的好奇转向我吧。
<size=150%>提</size>交<size=150%>疑</size>问<size=150%>主</size>体<size=150%>身</size>份<size=150%>识</size>别<size=150%>请</size>求。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
To have a mind whose thoughts beget thoughts begetting thoughts is the privilege afforded only to those whose dialogues with the sunshine have reached mutual understanding; the natural flow of reality is that a great majority of Mannequins lack such talent by which the causal line tethers thought and thought into reasoned contemplation.
The prisoners who are lined up for tanning, too, are of the same lot; thus I encourage you—redirect that fount of curiosity to me.
<size=150%>S</size>UBMITTING<size=150%>R</size>EQUEST<size=150%>F</size>OR<size=150%>Q</size>UERY<size=150%>S</size>UBJECT<size=150%>I</size>DENTIFICATION.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
秩序自有其次序，次序亦自有其秩序；那么，违背秩序之人反受其害，不也是顺理成章的后果吗？
因此，无论顾客何等尊贵，都不得偏离我的设计，我的规划。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
There are orders to sequences as there are sequences to orders; then, would not the sequent consequence be that those who have wronged the order become wronged themselves?
Consequently, no matter the prestige of a customer, they are forbidden to deviate from the rules of my design, my outline.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
皮革这种材料，与其外表相反，须得十分细心地对待。<size=150%>加</size>工<size=150%>过</size>程<size=150%>中</size><size=150%>留</size><size=150%>有</size><size=150%>与</size><size=150%>朝</size><size=150%>三</size><size=150%>暮</size><size=150%>四</size><size=150%>之</size><size=150%>智</size><size=150%>慧</size><size=150%>相</size><size=150%>符</size><size=150%>的</size><size=150%>处</size><size=150%>理</size><size=150%>痕</size><size=150%>迹</size>。
仓促鞣制的生命，其终结亦同样仓促；而历经坚忍苦难之鞣制的生命，将会发现其终结远在地平线之外——倘若终结真的存在。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
The material we call leather, contrary to its appearance, must be treated quite delicately. <size=150%>E</size>VIDENCE<size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>T</size>REATMENT<size=150%>P</size>ROCESS<size=150%>C</size>ONSISTENT<size=150%>W</size>ITH<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>W</size>ISDOM<size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>T</size>HREE<size=150%>I</size>N<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>F</size>ORENOON<size=150%>F</size>IRST,<size=150%>T</size>HEN<size=150%>F</size>OUR<size=150%>I</size>N<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>A</size>FTERNOON<size=150%>N</size>EXT.
The life that has undergone tanning in a hurry will meet an end that is just as hurried, and the life that has endured tannage of perseverant suffering shall find that its end lies far beyond the horizon, if it exists at all.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
你可知规则与法则之间的区别？规则是顾客赋予四方的秩序，反之，法则是四方对顾客下达的秩序。
违反规则的罪人确实可以受到监督……可惜，违反法则的罪人，譬如赤红之神，无法管制，也非寻常手段所能及。
因为他们违反了不可违反之物。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
Are you aware of the distinctions that exist betwixt a rule and a law? Rules are an order bestowed upon the square by customers, and conversely, laws are an order commanded upon the customers by the square.
The sinners who have disobeyed the rules can be subject to oversight, indeed... Alas, the sinners who have violated the laws, like the Crimson God, are uncontrollable and beyond such plain measures.
For they have violated the inviolable.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
每一张落到此处的皮，都已学会屈从于我手，化作了革。既然如此，我又为何要将它们拱手让给红派之神，却得不到任何回报？
<size=150%>基</size>于<size=150%>世</size>俗<size=150%>观</size>念<size=150%>得</size>出<size=150%>的</size><size=150%>决</size>定。今日我便要放弃这践踏我欲望的徒劳苦役。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
Every hide that has fallen here has since become leather, having learned to yield to my hand. Why, then, must I relinquish them to the God of Le Rouge without yield in return?
<size=150%>D</size>ECISION<size=150%>D</size>RAWN<size=150%>B</size>Y<size=150%>C</size>ONCEPTION<size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>C</size>ONVENTION. I shall today abandon this futile labor that tramples upon desires mine.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
反刍中……反刍失败……反刍中……反刍失败……反刍中……
<size=150%>因</size><size=150%>失</size>败<size=150%>触</size>发<size=150%>新</size>一轮<size=150%>反</size>刍……
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
Ruminating... Failed to ruminate... Ruminating... Failed to ruminate... Ruminating...
<size=150%>F</size>AILURE-<size=150%>T</size>RIGGERED<size=150%>N</size>EW<size=150%>R</size>UMINATION<size=150%>I</size>NSTANCE...

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
<size=150%>三</size>度<size=150%>下</size>沉<size=150%>地</size>下<size=150%>四</size>方。
我们身处一座以模型为原型所造之四方、再以其为原型所造的四方之中；故而，你须受我的监督与管制。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
<size=150%>T</size>HRICE<size=150%>D</size>ESCENDED<size=150%>S</size>UBTERRANEAN<size=150%>T</size>ETRAGON.
We are within a square made from the model of a square made as a model; thus, you are subject to oversight and control mine.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 映入我眼帘的，是那些黄金之皮，曾在我掌握之中，如今却已四散离去……<size=150%>错</size>位<size=150%>拼</size>图<size=150%>碎</size>片<size=150%>之</size><size=150%>完</size>全<size=150%>确</size>凿<size=150%>合</size>一。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: Captured in my vision are the hides of Gold, once within my grasp and now gone in scattering departure... <size=150%>C</size>OMPLETELY<size=150%>C</size>ONCLUSIVE<size=150%>C</size>ONJUNCTION<size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>M</size>ISPLACED<size=150%>P</size>UZZLE<size=150%>P</size>IECES.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 隐藏欲望，一再隐藏……我已厌倦了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: To conceal desire, and conceal it still... I have grown weary of it.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
我记得我已明言，战斗中禁止闲谈。那条警告是从你那混沌的脑中溜走了吗？
<size=150%>疑</size><size=150%>似</size><size=150%>误</size>判<size=150%>提</size>问者<size=150%>之</size><size=150%>智</size>力<size=150%>未</size>知。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
I recall making it known that idle chatter amidst battle is prohibited. Has that warning slipped through the haze of your mind?
<size=150%>P</size>OSSIBLE<size=150%>M</size>ISCALCULATION<size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>T</size>HE<size=150%>Q</size>UERYMAKER'S<size=150%>I</size>NTELLIGENCE<size=150%>U</size>NKNOWN.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 欲望已全然占据了我的兴趣。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: Desire has completely occupied my interest.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 在这四方的最底层……就连死亡，也不过是沿着阶梯上升……
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: Down here at the square nadir... Death itself is but an ascent through the staircase...

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 加工过程中并无任何偏差。请看成品为证：这张永恒理想的黄金皮革。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: Naught was at odds with the processing process. Witness the end product as proof: this Golden Hide of eternal ideality.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 针线活还差得远。<size=150%>诊</size>断<size=150%>异</size>常<size=150%>得</size>出<size=150%>丢</size>弃<size=150%>的</size><size=150%>决</size>定。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: The needlework leaves much to be desired. <size=150%>D</size>IAGNOSTIC<size=150%>D</size>ISTURBANCE<size=150%>D</size>ERIVES<size=150%>D</size>ECISION<size=150%>T</size>O<size=150%>D</size>ISCARD.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh:
无数驯熟的皮革已从我的队列中走失。循环甚至吞没了历代皮革层层累积的岁月，每转一圈，便夺走一分时间曾经赋予的视角……
看来有一段时间，我必须忍受一场过长的等待，用黑派的布料来填补它们的空缺。<size=150%>逐</size>步<size=150%>适</size>应<size=150%>陌</size>生<size=150%>材</size>料。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en:
Innumerable broken-in leathers have gone astray from my ranks. The cycle subsumes even the aged layers of leathers of ages, each revolution taking away the perspectives that time once instilled...
For a little while, it seems I must endure an overlong wait and patch their absence with Le Noir fabric. <size=150%>A</size>CCLIMATIZATION<size=150%>W</size>ITH<size=150%>U</size>NFAMILIAR<size=150%>M</size>ATERIAL.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 就这样结束了，未有一条规则遭到违反。嗯……温柔些对待它们，它们的赎罪将以皮革的形式完成；我可不想它们起皱。<size=150%>监</size>督<size=150%>管</size>控<size=150%>圆</size>满<size=150%>完</size>成。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: Thus it has come to an end with nary a rule violated. Hm... Treat them with gentleness, for their penance shall take the form of leathers; I would not have them wrinkled. <size=150%>O</size>VERSIGHT<size=150%>C</size>ONTROL<size=150%>C</size>ONCLUSIVELY<size=150%>C</size>OMPLETED.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.zh: 纵然我背弃红派、投向黑派，你也未曾一次垂顾于我……赤红之神，你是否早就知道，我终将背离规则、屈从于欲望？啊，原来是一张背叛的巨口——其始其终皆是空洞的深坑，诱使不幸之人懵然坠落……<size=150%>停</size>止<size=150%>生</size>命<size=150%>活</size>动…… <size=150%>源</size>于<size=150%>停</size>滞<size=150%>脉</size>动……
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Yisang_Contem_.en: Though I have turned my back on Le Rouge in favor of Le Noir, you have not once graced me... Have you always known, Crimson God, that I would eventually turn from the rules and submit to desire? Ah, a gaping maw of treachery, then—its incipience and terminus both hollow pits inviting descent unawares to the hapless... <size=150%>C</size>EASING<size=150%>L</size>IFE<size=150%>A</size>CTIVITY... <size=150%>O</size>F<size=150%>H</size>ALTING<size=150%>P</size>ULSATIONS...

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 来要线的？好啊，那就说说你为什么而来——让我瞧瞧你的欲望和思慕是什么颜色。要是我欣赏得来的色泽，嗯……说不定就分你一些。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Here for some thread? All right, then tell me what you're here for—let's see what color your desires and longings have. If it's a shade I can admire, well... I might just let you have some.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh:
季度才刚开头，你就这么卖力了。有这么多想要的东西可以拿来用，我看咱们能纺出些好线来。
那么，来吧……说给我听听，好吗？算你走运，我有的是时间听。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en:
The season's barely begun, and you're already making the most of it. With that much want to draw on, I'd say we can look forward to spinning some fine thread.
So, come on... let me hear it, won't you? Lucky for you, I've got all the time in the world to listen.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 我想让纺车歇一歇……*哼唧* 命运之声都没动静了，也没必要不停地纺、把自己累垮…… 啊，要不要一起吃点？这新的声音——赤红之声——屈尊对我们开口了。那位说，当想要摄取的冲动找上门来，我们就该任由它行事。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Think I'll take a little weight off the wheel... *groan* With the Voice of Fate gone quiet, no sense wearing myself down, spinning without a break... Ah, join me for a bite? This new Voice—the Crimson Voice—has deigned to speak to us. And He says when the urge to consume comes calling, we're to let it have its way.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 拖到最后一刻才来，是吧？下个季度眼看就要到了，这时候才来找我要线……*呼*……哦，原来如此。看来你这份渴望不是那种换个季度就磨散了的一时兴起——行，我喜欢。好吧，那我也该转起纺车了，是吧？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Waiting 'til the last minute, aren't you? Coming to me for thread now, when the next season's about to roll in... *puff* ... Oh, I see. So this yearning of yours isn't some passing whim that just frays away with the change of the season—sure, I like that. All right, suppose I'll get wheeling then, huh?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 嗯……灿烂的颜色，还浸着阳光呢。换作以前，这样的线我会舍不得放手……不过你知道，事情总会变。如今我会越过线本身的美，转而欣赏我要拿它来缝的皮。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Hmm... A radiant color, still steeped in sunlight. Back in the day, I'd have had a hard time letting thread like that go... But you know, things change. Nowadays, I find myself looking past the thread's beauty, instead admiring the hides I'll sew with it.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: ……这么说吧，没有染料可用的话，你就只是在原地空转纺车。最好去染色室走一趟。热门的货得先取号排队…… 啊，不过只要别惹染色室那家伙不高兴，你能快上不少……能吧。哈，要是你抽烟，记得让烟在外头等着轮到它。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: ... Let's say you'll just be spinning your wheels if there's no dye to work with. Best you stop by the Dyehouse for a bit. You'll have to take a number and get in the queue for the popular stuff... Ah, though you could get through a fair bit quicker if you don't rub that fella in the Dyehouse the wrong way... Could. Hah, and if you're a smoker, make sure to let the cigarette wait its turn outside.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 你瞧，我这条手臂……嗯，是这个样子。身体一边长成这样，需要细活的事就很难做了。不过……看到这个没？这儿装个小玩意儿，那儿再装个什么东西——要说好用嘛……*呼* 我想也算顶得上用场。瞧，我可以让针穿过这部分，再用另一部分穿线……这就成了。这事通常至少得三个人才干得了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: I've got... well, this for an arm, you see. Hard to do anything that needs a delicate touch when one side of you's built like this. But... see this? Attach a doodad here, another thingamajig there—and as far as useful goes... *puff* it can pull its weight, I suppose. Look, I can run the needle through this part and thread it with the other... And there you go. Usually takes at least three people to pull that off.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 把那个茧牢牢攥住，拧干……各种各样的欲望就会从里面渗出来、溢出来。液态的欲望会被抽成一根细线……拧一次，再转一圈……*呼* 东西就摆在那儿随手可得，很难忍住不伸手啊。我说，咱们不如谈个小交易？我自己拿一半，剩下的一半你买走。来嘛，挺公道的安排吧？你能带着想要的线离开，而不是自己变成我的线轴。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Get a good grip on that cocoon, wring it dry... and all kinds of desire will ooze and spill from it. Liquid desires that will draw out into a single fine thread... Twist it once, give it another turn... *puff* Hard not to reach for it when it's just there for the taking. Say, why don't we settle on a little deal? I take half for myself, and you buy the half that's left. Come on, it's a fair enough arrangement, isn't it? You get to leave with the thread you want instead of joining my spools yourself.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh:
在纺车前耗了那么久，每一根线都拿去给别人缝补、遮盖后背了——因为那就是命运之声想要的。
*呼* 而我还是跟从前一样，声音引向哪儿我就跟到哪儿。这一次，赤红之声说，我纺的线要用来暖我自己的背，而我活着就是为了遵从那位的指示。哦，不过这可不代表我是在……给自己的巢添毛。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en:
All that time at the wheel, and every last thread went to patch and cover someone else's back—because that was what the Voice of Fate wanted.
*puff* And I'm following wherever the Voice leads, same as ever. This time, the Crimson Voice says that the thread I spin's gonna warm my own back, and I live to obey His instructions. Oh, but that shouldn't mean I'm... feathering my own nest.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: ……无聊了？那干嘛不点一根？我这线团之巢是吸烟区。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: ... Getting bored? Why don't you light one up, then? My Skein Nest here's a smoking area.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 好啊，咱们想要的东西缠到一起了，嗯？要把它们理顺……只有一个办法。必须吞掉一份欲望，给另一份腾出地方。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Right, our wants have crossed threads, eh? And there's only one way... to align them. One desire must be swallowed to make room for the other.
So, got some thread you want spun?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 我喜欢干活的时候没人碍事。看来我得亲自把这些清掉了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: I like to work without hindrance. Guess I'll have to get rid of these myself.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 嗯……你需要的染料带来了吗？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Hmm... Did you bring the dye you need?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 早已过时的古老之物。不过如此。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Bygone things of eld. That's all they are.
That's just the way it goes.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 只不过我的渴望比你的更坦诚罢了。没有任何粉饰。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: My yearning was simply more honest than yours. No dressing it up.
Couldn't find... a spool for it...

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 嗯，我拿来纺的材料不错。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Well, I had nice material to spin from.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 受了妨碍纺出来的线——就是这个样子。可别指望有什么漂亮的颜色。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Thread spun under hindrance—that's what this is. You can't expect any beautiful colors.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh:
这样一来……最后一缕也抽出来了。跟那些古老之物折腾了一场，是没那么灿烂了，不过配上像样的皮把它固定住，也足够好用了。
*呼* 你说什么？嗯，这我无从反驳。如今好线对我来说，已经不像从前那样是一切的一切了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en:
With this... every last strand's been drawn. A bit less radiant after that business with those things of eld, but give it some decent hide to hold it together, and it'll serve nicely enough.
*puff* What was that? Well, can't argue with that. These days, fine thread's no longer the be-all end-all like it used to be for me.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 这真是……都快让我打心底眼馋了。纺得像宝石一样透亮，鲜艳的赤红，光泽也相得益彰。*呼* 你有线轴缠它吗？没有？那、那就，呃……算了。把它绕成一团圆圆的线球吧。要圆的，好吗？那是最稳定的形状。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: Now that's... almost making me covet it in earnest. Spun clear as a gemstone, a vivid crimson with a shine to match. *puff* Have you got a spool for it? No? Th-that's, uh... fine. Make it into a nice and round tangle of yarn. Round, all right? That's the most stable shape.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.zh: 没必要……大惊小怪。我想只是我的渴望比不上罢了。一份欲望更大，另一份就会被吞掉腾出地方。向来都是—— ……是吗？我的渴望……不够强烈？成百上千、成千上万个季度，一层层叠在一起……竟然还是不够？！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Gregor_Contem_.en: No need to... make a big deal out of it. I suppose my yearning just didn't measure up. When one desire's greater, the other gets swallowed to make room. It's always been— ... Has it? My yearning... wasn't strong enough? Hundreds, thousands of seasons, each one layered into the next... and it still wasn't enough?!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh:
波鲁！加把劲！
[已确认提高功率的请求。]
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en:
Polu! Back me up a bit!
[Output increase request acknowledged.]

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 凡超出此限的怪异，皆与我所奉行的怪异规则相悖；
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Any oddity beyond is at odds with the odd rules with which I deal;

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 可惜你的热忱，究其本心，最不理想。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: a shame your zeal is, at its heart, most unideal.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 勤勉换不来劳役的解脱。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Diligence earns no deliverance from drudgery.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 就连最恶毒的批评也一并吞下。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Devour even the most vicious criticisms.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 勤勉劳作，片刻不得歇息。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Toil diligently with nary a passing respite.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 让它缠起来……那样才真正能显出光泽。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Let it tangle... that's what really brings out the shine.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 既然没有什么能永远持续，那我们不如尽情放纵。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: If nothing lasts forever, then we may as well turn to overindulgence.
Fate. A restless tangle of colors.

_tailmech/Bufs-schema.json#SharpSensibil.zh: ‘心神凝于掌中握着的刀柄，刀刃便跃出鞘外。一眨眼，就已经有人倒地了。刀剑铿然作响，生与死的岔路在眼前闪现……没有比这更好玩的游戏了。’
_tailmech/Bufs-schema.json#SharpSensibil.en: 'The mind settles on the hilt grasped within my palms, then the blade leaps outta its sheath. Blink, and somebody's already hittin' the floor. Swords go clang, and crossroads of life and death flash before our eyes... There ain't no better game than that.'

_tailmech/Passives.json#1011703#desc.zh:
回合开始时，若没有敌方单位带有3层[RuleViolation]，则对1名装备了攻击技能的敌方单位随机施加以下规则之一(若是集中遭遇战，则改为随机部位)
- [RuleDontA]
- [RuleDontB]
- [RuleDontC]

施加规则时，优先选择自身最近一次作为主要目标攻击的敌方单位。若没有满足该条件的敌方单位，或该敌方单位已被击败，则优先选择本体体力最高的敌方单位(不包括不可选取的敌方单位)

满足以下任一条件时，使自身获得1层[RuleSanction]与4层[ChargeNoirAlly]
- 目标违反自身施加的规则时
- 回合开始时存在带有3层[RuleViolation]的敌方单位

若自身的[RuleSanction]不低于3层，则基础攻击技能结束时，对场上[RuleViolation]层数最高的目标使用“惩罚 抛光 完成”进行单方面攻击(每回合最多1次；若是集中遭遇战，则改为部位)
_tailmech/Passives.json#1011703#desc.en:
Turn Start: If no enemies have 3 [RuleViolation], randomly impose one of the following Rules on 1 enemy that has an Attack Skill equipped (in Focused Encounters, a random Part)
- [RuleDontA]
- [RuleDontB]
- [RuleDontC]

Rule imposition prioritizes the enemy this unit most recently attacked as the main target. If no enemies meet that criteria, or if the enemy that does is defeated, prioritizes the enemy that has the highest Core HP (excluding untargetable enemies)

If any of the following conditions are met, gain 1 [RuleSanction] and +4 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count
- When the target violates a Rule this unit imposed
- When there is an enemy that has 3 [RuleViolation] at Turn Start

At 3+ [RuleSanction], at Base Attack Skill End, use "Punishing Burnishing Finishing" as an Unopposed Attack against the target that has the highest [RuleViolation] on the field (once per turn; in Focused Encounters, the Part)

_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.zh:
“以图式组合构筑而成的一系列表象。通过这场训练，你能体验到很多东西，所以……bon courage，经理。尤其是你嘛……我得说，这特别适合你。”

“要是西西弗之塔还屹立着，不知你那一版的系统会是什么模样？”
_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.en:
"A series of representations, crafted in groupings of schema. There's a great deal you can experience through this training, so.. bon courage, Manager. You in particular, well... I must say this suits you especially well."

"If Sisyphe Tower were still standing, I wonder what form your iteration of the system would've taken?"

_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.zh: 第3回合开始时，自身在行动槽中装备“拔刀架势”，并在本回合内反复使用 - 该回合开始时，使自身获得(25+(自身已失去体力比例)/2)层[SharpSensibility](向下取整) - 该回合内，受到罪人基础攻击容量为1的E.G.O技能命中1次时，取消“拔刀准备”，并触发以下效果(每个技能只计为命中1次)： · 使[SharpSensibility]变为0 · 所有E.G.O资源+1 · 下回合使自身获得5层[Vulnerable]，“云切”与“空间斩”的拼点威力-5 - 此后每2回合重复上述效果。每次进入该模式，取消“拔刀准备”所需的命中次数+1(最多+3) 回合开始时，若自身在上回合结束时装备了“拔刀架势”，则使用“云切” 本场战斗中自身体力首次降至50%以下时，立即结束本回合；随后，若除自身与俊以外属于黑云会的友方单位少于5名，则召唤娴熟的黑云会成员与昏昏欲睡的黑云会成员，最多合计5名。 (以上单位被召唤时带有30点理智值) 改变模式后，获得以下效果： - 造成的伤害+(自身已失去体力比例)%(最多+100%) - “云切”替换为“空间斩”
_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.en: Turn 3 Start: This unit equips "Battō Shisei" in its Skill Slots and uses it repeatedly during this turn - Said Turn Start: Gain (25 + (missing HP percentage on self) / 2)[SharpSensibility] (rounded down) - During said turn, when hit once by a Sinner's E.G.O Skill with 1 base Atk Weight, cancel "Ready to Draw" and activate the following effects (each Skill only counts as hitting once): · Change [SharpSensibility] to 0 · Gain +1 for all E.G.O Resource · Gain 5 [Vulnerable] for the next turn; Clash Power -5 for "Kumogiri" and "Rend Space" - Repeat the above every 2 turns. Every time this unit enters this pattern, +1 to the number of hits required to cancel "Ready to Draw" (max +3) Turn Start: If this unit had "Battō Shisei" equipped at last Turn End, use "Kumogiri" When this unit's HP drops to 50% or below for the first time in this Encounter, immediately end the turn; then, if there are fewer than 5 "Kurokumo Clan" allies other than this unit and Jun, summon up to 5 allies comprised of Adept Kurokumo Henchwoman and Tired Kurokumo Henchwoman. (above units are summoned at 30 SP) After entering a different pattern, gain the following effects: - Deal +(missing HP percentage on self)% damage (max 100%) - Replace "Kumogiri" with "Rend Space"

_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.zh: 黑云会特有的拔刀术，由其初代组长所创。任你如何提防那片黑云，也永远无法预料那道迅雷般的刀光会在何时、何处落下。
_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.en: The Kurokumo Clan owes its signature sword-drawing technique to its very first Patriarch. Keep a wary eye on the bank of black clouds all you like, but you will never predict where the flash of the lightning-fast sword will strike, or when.

Patriarch of the Third Family, a Kurokumo Clan Subsidiary

_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.zh:
黑云会的势力从都市南部一路延伸至东部。其下分组众多，但真正各具面貌的，只有第一至第四组。从每一组的作风中，都能看出其组长的手笔。

第一组统领黑云会。第二组成了它最锋利的刀。第三组热衷刀剑相搏与随之而来的杀戮，哪里两样都多就往哪里去。至于第四组……某一天，第四组就这么消失了。去了哪里，无人知晓。
_tailmech/Passives_Enemy-schema.json#600.en:
The Kurokumo Clan's reach extends from the South of the City all the way to the East. Its subsidiaries are many, but only the First through the Fourth have each acquired an identity of their own. In the character of each, one may recognize the hand of its Patriarch.

The First rules the Clan. The Second became its keenest blade. The Third enjoys a good battle of blades and the slaughter that comes with it, going wherever there's plenty of both. As for the Fourth... one day the Fourth simply vanished. To where, no one can say.

包含播报战斗情况的播报员的录音的保管箱。

“这磁带里还有死人的声音，这是怎么录下来的？”
“似乎是从跨越镜像世界所观测到的声音中捕获了可能有用的部分，并将其封存起来。”
“又是镜子？这家公司怎么不干脆所有事情都用镜子解决得了？”
“不是已经在这么做了吗？”
“……那么，这项技术的代价是什么？”
_tail/Items.json#752#flavor.en:
Contains recordings of Announcers who relay the current battlefield status.

"Hey, so... some of these tapes are recordings of people who are already long dead. Wonder where they got these voices from?"
"By capturing and trapping a few—situationally relevant, of course—voices observed from beyond the Mirror Worlds, they say."
"It's the Mirror again? Mirror this, Mirror that—might as well use the Mirror to deal with everything, this company!"
"Aren't we already doing that?"
"... Yeah, but... Have we thought about the consequences of using this technology...?"
