_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 好的皮革，必须按部就班、在管制之下制成。若能用它做成衣服穿在身上，说不定还能登上楼上，站上T台呢。姿态尚堪入目。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Fine leather requires proper procedure and careful supervision. Make yourself an outfit from it, and you may yet reach the upper floors, and perhaps even take your place on the runway. PASSABLE LOOK.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 顾客死后留下皮，人台死后也留下皮。回收遗物。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Customers leave their hides behind when they pass away. Mannequins do the same, of course. RETRIEVING THE DECEASED'S EFFECTS.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 皮磨损得厉害呢。原料受损。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: I am afraid the hide is showing considerable wear. RAW STOCK DETERIORATION.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 这副模样，跟破布也没什么两样了。用不了多久，就能拼出一件拼布作品了。策划新款纸样。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: You are looking rather ragged. We should soon have enough materials for a patchwork piece. DRAFTING NEW PATTERN.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 呼嗯嗯嗯……！您也看见了吗？那张马上就要落入我怀中的原皮！期待感增幅。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Hrrrngh...! Can you see it, too? That raw hide... soon to be nestled in my arms! ANTICIPATION RISING.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 嗯……脱离管制了呢。审议再收监。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Hmm... No longer under control, are we? REINCARCERATION UNDER REVIEW.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 收获的时间。请把每一张原皮、每一颗眼珠都一个不落地搜刮干净。转移所有权。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Time to harvest. Please pick the floor clean of every eyeball and scrap of raw hide. OWNERSHIP REASSIGNED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 下一名罪犯请准备~补充人员。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Next prisoner, please be ready~ PERSONNEL REPLENISHMENT.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 表面留下的伤口虽然可惜，不过嘛……没关系。我也很擅长做绒面革呢。削切表皮。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: A shame about the surface damage, but... no matter. I make excellent suede, too. EPIDERMAL SHAVING.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 一切都在按流程进行。确认流程有效。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Everything is proceeding by the book. PROCEDURAL VALIDITY CONFIRMED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 偶尔也有客人会下特别订单，要用历经种种艰难险阻、被磨砺得坚韧无比的皮来做东西。嗯……现在正合适呢。达成理想包浆。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Some customers do request special commissions: pieces made from hide toughened by adversity, with every hardship written into it. Hmm... the current circumstances should suit their needs nicely. DESIRED PATINA ACHIEVED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 只剩最后的抛光了，要是在这一步搞砸，可就太可惜了吧？刺激挑战欲望。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: We have only the final polishing to attend to. Surely you would not wish to spoil the work at this stage? AMBITION DRIVE STIMULATED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 呜……我感觉到了……被夹在绷皮架上、痛苦挣扎的皮的声音……观测到破裂征兆。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Ngh... I can feel it... The sheets of hide are writhing in agony, crying, clamped in the stretcher... RUPTURE INDICATORS DETECTED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 观察中……嗯，这似乎是个例外情况呢。请求例外处理。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: OBSERVATION ONGOING... Hmm. This would appear to be an exception to the usual procedure. EXCEPTION PROCESSING REQUESTED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 刮肉刮得真干净呢。手艺出众。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Such clean fleshing. CRAFTSMANSHIP COMMENDED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 您到底有没有查过裁剪规定？确认懈怠。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Might I ask whether you even bothered to consult the cutting regulations? INDOLENCE DETECTED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 很标准的铬鞣呢。正适合上染料。工序合理。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: That is a fine example of proper chrome tanning. The leather should be beautifully receptive to dye. PROCEDURE DEEMED SOUND.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 真是叫人脸红的判断呢。共感性羞耻。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: What an embarrassing decision you've made. SECONDHAND EMBARRASSMENT.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 有股昂贵药剂的味道呢。究竟用了什么？掌握竞品情报。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: I detect the scent of some rather costly chemicals. Might I ask what was used? ASSESSING RIVAL PRODUCTS.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 请先把生了蛆的部分剜掉。需要积极修边。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Please begin by removing the sections where the maggots have settled. AGGRESSIVE TRIMMING REQUIRED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 哦……您带回了什么？罪犯们身上透出一股贵气呢。欢迎附加服务。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Oh... may I ask what you have managed to procure? You prisoners have acquired quite an air of refinement. ADDITIONAL SERVICE WELCOMED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 哎呀！明明是油鞣革，竟然干成那样。我应该叮嘱过要用心刷理的吧。玩忽职守。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Oh dear! To find oil-tanned hide in such a dry condition. I believe I asked you to pay closer attention to the brushing. DUTIES NEGLECTED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 刚片下来的那块，拿来做薄外套正合适呢。流露欲望。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: That freshly skived scrap is just the thing to make a lightweight coat. DESIRE EXPRESSED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 啊，掉下来的碎肉请送去预处理区。别忘了压上我的标志。确保剩余库存。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Ah, please have the fallen meat scraps sent to the pretreatment area. And do ensure they bear my stamped logo. SURPLUS INVENTORY SECURED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 不合常理呢。怀疑对象的智力。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Behavior inconsistent with common sense. QUESTIONING SUBJECT'S INTELLIGENCE.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 脸上那两个眼洞，不是为了看东西，是因为粒面皮不够才挖的吗？疑问产生。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Did you cut open those eyeholes on your face not to see, but to compensate for a shortage of grain leather? NEW DOUBT FORMED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 啊……感叹与称赞。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Ah... AMAZEMENT AND COMPLIMENTS.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 很好。就这样，再集中一点。从脖子一刀直线划下来再剥出来，就能毫无损伤地取得原皮了。进行野外处理。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Very good. Just so. A little more attention, please. Make a straight cut from the neck, then ease it free... and the raw hide should remain intact. FIELD DRESSING UNDERWAY.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 那么多只，竟然都把手脚卸得干干净净！看来不必吝惜夸奖了。表彰功绩。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: What an immaculate limb removal technique, on so many specimens at that! I must offer you my highest compliments. MERITORIOUS WORK RECOGNIZED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 残次品……？当然一件也没有。我的工序完美无缺。确认完美无瑕。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Defects...? Zero, of course. My process was flawless. PERFECTION CONFIRMED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 规定……未遵守。流程……未执行。结果……连再生革都不如……全体罪犯集合。预告……追加鞣制。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Regulations... violated. Procedures... ignored. The result... it falls short of even bonded leather... All prisoners, kindly assemble. FURTHER TANNING... SCHEDULED.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.zh: 工作时间到了哦~部署罪犯。和往常一样，在我的管制下，进行一场优雅的制革吧。开始作业。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Overs.en: Time to begin work, if you please~ PRISONERS ASSIGNED. Under my supervision, the tanning we perform will be elegant as always. COMMENCING OPERATIONS.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 当铺
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: A Pawnshop

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
要知道，光是运气差、钱包空，还不足以让人心甘情愿地走进当铺。人们远比想象中更能默默忍受那破烂又窝囊的“凑合过日子”的喧嚣……直到连对明天那一丝渺茫的期待也离他们而去。
到了那时，人们才会涌进这间昏暗的铺子，准备放下自己过往中最珍贵的东西。

陈列架上摆着饰有浮雕纹样的右臂义肢、一张不知开往何处的火车票，还有一支虽已生锈、却似乎还能值点钱的钢笔。

你尴尬地踌躇着，店主却显然早已见过成千上万个你这样的人，连头都没抬，就问道：“要当什么？”

你翻了翻口袋，然后……
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
You see, it takes more than a run of bad luck and an empty wallet for someone to step into a pawnshop willingly. People are more inclined to endure the shabby, wretched racket of "getting by" than one might think. ... Until even their faint hopes for tomorrow desert them.
That's when they start crowding this dingy place, ready to part with the most precious pieces of their past.

On the display, you see a prosthetic right arm adorned with raised patterns, a train ticket to who-knows-where, and a rusted fountain pen that still looks as though it might fetch something.

You linger awkwardly, but the owner has clearly seen your sort a thousand times before. Without so much as looking up, they ask, "So, what do you have?"

You rummage through your pockets and...

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 把身上的东西全都放到柜台上。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Lay everything I have on the counter.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 只拿出自己最不值钱的一样东西。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Offer only the least valuable thing I own.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 避开那审视的目光，拔腿就跑。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Turn away from that appraising gaze and make a run for it.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 替考
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Stand-in Exam

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
聚在小巷里的一群人朝你走来。

“你也知道，明天的实操考试……嗯，他们核对长相不怎么仔细。”

你很快就明白了这些人想说什么。

“而且我家孩子还太小了。经验也不够。”

旁边的人接过了话头。

“可听说要是这个月底前把证全拿下来，下个月的入职面试就能加分……”

没有人提那究竟是什么考试。不过，像你这样的人，或许能帮他们在追寻巢中生活的梦想之路上，稍微推上一把？
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
You are approached by a group gathered in an alley.

"You know, for tomorrow's practical exam... well, let's say they're not too particular about checking faces. 

It doesn't take long for you to work out what they're getting at.

"And my children are still so young. They just don't have much experience."

Someone beside them picks up the thread.

"But we've heard that if they earn all their certifications by the end of this month, they'll get extra points at next month's job interviews..."

Nobody mentions what the exam is actually for. Still, perhaps people like you might be able to give these people a small leg up on their way to achieving that dream of Nest life?

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 派一名罪人去。虽然对方一脸不情愿，但总得有人去。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Send one Sinner. They don't look happy about it, but someone has to do it.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 抽签派两名罪人去。这样应该能让尽可能多的考生通过。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Draw lots and send two Sinners. That should give as many applicants as possible a chance to pass.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 不掺和。搬进巢里，从来就没有这么容易。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Stay out of it. Moving into a Nest is never going to be that easy.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 没有空位的游乐场
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: An Overcrowded Playground

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
一辆满载着某人家当的搬家卡车挤进了狭窄的小巷。游乐场里的孩子们齐刷刷地转过头来，可惜——没有一张脸露出欢迎的神色。

“可是游乐场已经满了。红秋千上八个，绿秋千上五个，滑梯上十个，台阶上四个半，跷跷板上十个。”

看上去像是孩子王的那个孩子一字一顿、清清楚楚地数着人头。

“那新来的孩子，到底该放在哪儿呢？”
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
A moving truck loaded with someone's belongings squeezes into the narrow alley. Every child in the playground turns to look, but what a shame—not a single face lights up in welcome.

"But the playground's already full. 8 on the red swings, 5 on the green ones, 10 on the slide, 4.5 on the steps, and 10 on the seesaw."

The child who seems to be in charge counts the kids off, each syllable crisp and clear.

"Where are we even supposed to put the new kid?"

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 沙地上。那是留给迟来者的唯一位置。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: On the sand. It's the only place left for a latecomer.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 红秋千上。再挤一挤，或许还能塞下一个？
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: On the red swings. Maybe there's room to squeeze in just one more?

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 不参与点名。背对孩子们走开。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Stay out of the headcount. Turn my back on the children and walk away.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 伪造名片
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Counterfeit Business Card

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
“你可以成为任何人。哪怕是你连做梦都不敢想的人。”

店主熟练地推销着，看样子没少应付过有故事的人。
可尽管许下这么多豪言壮语，他手里拿着的，不过是几张名片而已。

“至少在这张小纸片上，你就是K公司的队长。想的话，当个5级收尾人事务所的所长也行。不过可别忘了，要是有检查员找上门，这里就是家水果店，而你今天买走的，只有一个熟透的苹果。”

只要手里握着一张精心伪造的名片……你就可以成为任何人。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
"You could be anyone. Even someone you never dared to dream of being."

The owner runs through the pitch with the ease of someone who's heard more than a few hard-luck stories.
For all the grand promises, though, they're holding nothing more than a few business cards.

"On this little piece of paper, at least, you're a team leader at K Corp. Or the director of a Grade 5 Fixer Office, if you prefer. Mind you, if the inspectors come knocking, this is a fruit shop, and all you've bought today is a nice, ripe apple."

With one of those artfully forged cards in hand... you could be anyone.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 试着成为别人。只要不是现在的我，谁都行。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Try being someone else. Anyone will do, so long as it isn't who I am now.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 成为翼的新员工。这样应该能让很多人羡慕得眼红。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Become a new hire at a Wing. That should leave plenty of people green with envy.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 维持现在的我。仔细想想，这样的人生也不算太坏。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Stick with who I am. This life isn't so bad, all things considered.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 破布山
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: A Hill of Rags

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
拥挤的市场摊位之间，一座小山映入你的眼帘。凑近一看，你很快发现那是层层叠叠堆起来的衣物；或许整座镇子的待洗衣物都流落到这堆里来了吧？那是被穿得单薄、起皱、揉烂、脏污、发臭的人生与经历。

或许带一件走也无妨，留着以后用。总有一天，我们自己的衣服也会流落到这座山脚下……
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
Between the crowded market stalls, a hill rises into your view. You take a closer look, soon realizing that it contains layers upon layers of clothing; perhaps the whole town's laundry has found its way into the pile? It's their lives and experiences worn thin, creased, crumpled, filthy, reeking.

Maybe it wouldn't hurt to take an outfit along, something to set aside for later. Our own clothes will find their way down to the foot of this hill one day...

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 拿一套西装。再漂洗一遍、好好熨一熨，说不定还挺像样。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Take a suit. Another rinse and a good ironing might make it look presentable enough.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 拿一张……某种东西的皮。在这些街道上游荡，或许总有时候，看起来像个人并不是什么好主意。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Take the hide of... something. Wandering these streets, there may come a time when looking human isn't such a good idea.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 什么也不拿。身上穿的就够了。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Take nothing. What I'm wearing will do.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 空无一人的车站
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: An Empty Bus Stop

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
你来到一处车站，四下不见人影。
一辆不知从何而来的公交车停在你面前；你也不知道它要开往哪里。
仿佛是在回报你等待的漫长时光，它连喇叭都不按一声，耐心地等着你。
但它不会永远等下去。
毕竟，即使夜幕已经降临，后巷还会迎来另一个夜晚……
你最好赶快决定怎么回家。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
You find yourself at a bus stop, not a soul to be seen.
A bus from nowhere pulls up in front of you; you have no idea where it's going.
As though returning the favor for all the time you've spent waiting, it waits patiently without so much as a honk.
But it won't wait for you forever.
Even after night has fallen, the Backstreets have another night in store, after all...
You'd better decide how you're getting home, and quickly.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 上车。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Get on the bus.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 按记忆中的方向步行离开。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Head off on foot, following the way I remember.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 让公交车开走，留在车站。可还会有下一班吗？
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Let the bus go and stay at the stop. But will there even be another one?

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 白夜
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: White Nights

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
你看见一道耀眼的光柱直冲天际，光芒穿过密密麻麻的楼宇间的缝隙。整个世界都亮了起来，仿佛夜晚本身已不复存在。
后巷的人们一个接一个地抬头望向天空。
在那温和而温暖的光芒之下，你……
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
You see a brilliant pillar of light shooting up to the sky, its rays cutting through the gaps between the tightly packed buildings. Your whole world lights up, as though night itself has ceased to exist.
One by one, the people of the Backstreets lift their heads toward the sky.
Beneath that gentle, warm light, you...

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 和大家一起仰望天空。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Look up at the sky with everyone else.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 低头看着在坑洼路面上四散的光。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Look down at the light scattering across the uneven pavement.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 只是紧紧闭上眼睛。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Just squeeze my eyes shut.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 贴满传闻的墙
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: A Wall Full of Rumors

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
从鸡毛蒜皮的跑腿到探险乃至买凶杀人，收尾人从来不缺活儿干，对吧？
每份委托的报酬看起来都还算公道。至少表面上如此。
但要接下哪一个、对哪一个视而不见呢？选择权在你手里。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
From petty errands to expeditions and contract killings, there's never a shortage of work for a Fixer, is there?
The pay for each job looks fair enough. On paper, at least.
But which will you take, and which will you turn a blind eye to? The choice is yours.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 都市怪谈。接下早已熟悉的那类委托。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Urban Myth. Take on the sort of job that's familiar enough.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 追查一条或许能赚钱的传闻。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Follow a Canard that might turn a profit.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 都市传说。接下报酬丰厚的委托。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Urban Legend. Take on a job that offers a hefty payout.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 一份委托也不接。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Take none of the contracts.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 熟悉又陌生的小巷
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Familiar Yet Unknown Alleyways

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 迷宫般的小巷网络蜿蜒延伸，拐过一个弯又是一个弯。这片后巷与你记忆中的每一条小巷都相似，却又没有一条让人感到熟悉。你不停地走，拐了一个又一个弯，却看不到尽头。就在这时，你忽然意识到：那股一直牵动着你注意力的奇怪感觉是……
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: The labyrinthine network of alleyways winds on, one turn after another. These Backstreets resemble every alley you can remember, yet somehow none of them feel familiar. You keep walking, turn after turn, but there's no end in sight. Then, all at once, a sudden realization comes to you: this odd feeling that's been tugging at your attention is...

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 周围逼近的黑暗。最好掏出终端看看时间。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: The darkness closing in around me. Better take out my PDA and check the time.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
凌晨3点13分。
当“深宵”降临后巷，他们就会到来。
待到日出，什么痕迹都不会留下。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
3:13 AM.
When the "Night" falls on the Backstreets, they come.
Come sunrise, there won't be a trace of anything left behind.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 不知从哪里飘来的音乐。节奏很欢快。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Music drifting from somewhere. It's got a catchy beat.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 锁链叮当作响。张狂的大笑。没错，中指从不会忘记。一旦被他们记恨上，你这辈子都只能东躲西藏……最终也只会在某个小巷口，发现他们早已在那里等着你。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Clinking chains. Boisterous guffaw. Right, the Middle never forgets. Once you're in their bad books, you'll be on the run for the rest of your life... only to inevitably find them waiting at the mouth of some alleyway.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 什么东西在叫的声音……
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: The sound of something barking...

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 一只叫了起来，很快每条小巷都跟着一齐吠叫。四条腿的东西在这些街道上爬行，连自己该守护的是什么都没搞明白，就冲着空中嚎叫。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: One starts barking, and soon every alley is barking in tandem. The four-legged things crawl on these streets, howling into the air without even figuring out what they are meant to guard.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 没什么值得停下的。继续走。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Nothing worth stopping for. Keep walking.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 我决定继续往前走。我在等待的东西，或许根本不在这条小巷里。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: I decide to keep moving. What I'm waiting for might not be in this alley at all.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 没什么要紧的。我已经不想再在乎任何事了。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Nothing that matters. I don't want to care about anything anymore.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 不管那是什么，我都没兴趣弄清楚。那些动静很快就会平息。然后，又会有别的什么来填满这片寂静。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Whatever it is, I have no desire to find out. Soon, those stirrings will die away. Then something else will come along to fill the silence.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 黑云
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Dark Cloud

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
你误入了一片迷宫般的小巷网络的尽头。
你踏入的这片后巷不同于你走过的任何街道；它既陌生，又漠不关心。
仅以记忆为画纸，你开始描绘这片后巷里的生活，毫不在意孰真孰假，孰强孰弱……
当街道的漠不关心变成一种具体而不受欢迎的关注时，从你思绪中伸展出的黑云，也在小巷上投下同样漫长而黑暗的阴影。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
You wander into the cul-de-sac of some labyrinthine network of alleyways.
This Backstreets you've stepped into is unlike any street you've walked before; it is at once unfamiliar and disinterested.
With nothing but your memories as drawing paper, you begin sketching the life in this Backstreets, caring little for what is true or false, what is weak or powerful...
As the disinterest of the streets turns into a specific, unwelcome interest, black clouds stretching from your thoughts cast shadows just as long and dark over the alleyway.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 斩开云层。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Cut through the cumulus.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh:
东部十剑。剑鬼。修罗。
每一位曾背负那些名号的武者，都一次又一次将我带到地狱之门前，以痛苦为烙印，深深烙进我的记忆。

在这里等待着的是……
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en:
Ten Blades of the East. Blade Fiend. Ashura.
Each warrior who held one of those titles has brought me again and again before the gates of hell, searing themselves deep into my memories with agony as their brand.

Here awaits...

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 逃离云层。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: Flee from the cumulus.

_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.zh: 没有必要踏入构筑出来的世界。
_tail/SchemaCraftChoice.json#schemacraft.en: There is no need to step into the crafted world.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式构筑
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Schemacraft

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式构筑
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Schemacraft

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在图式构筑中，你将掷骰子探索图式，并用战斗奖励获得的人格与E.G.O逐步组建队伍。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: In Schemacraft, you roll dice to explore Schemas and build your team with Identities and E.G.O earned from battle rewards.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗会自动进行。选择要前往哪个表象、领取哪些奖励、何时使用E.G.O，以击败最终头目为目标。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Battles play out automatically. Choose which Representations to visit, which rewards to claim, and when to use E.G.O as you make your way to the Final Boss.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 进入
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Enter

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 选择“进入”后，将前往初始编队界面。若有正在进行的图式构筑，可选择“继续”接着进行，或选择“重新开始”开始新的一局。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Select "Enter" to open the Starting Team screen. If a run is already in progress, select "Continue" to resume it or "Fresh Start" to begin a new one.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式构筑通行证
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Schemacraft Pass

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 进行图式构筑可获得图式构筑通行证经验，并可随通行证等级提升领取奖励。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Earn Schemacraft Pass EXP by playing Schemacraft, and claim rewards as your Pass levels up.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 初始编队
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Starting Team

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 最多编入4名人格，开始图式构筑。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Select up to 4 Identities to start your Schemacraft run with.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 手动编队
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Manual Team

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在可用费用范围内亲自选择人格。高费用人格可编入的数量有限。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Manually recruit Identities within the available Cost limit. There is a limit to how many high-Cost Identities you can select.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 随机编队
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Randomized Team

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 获得一支费用上限高于手动编队的随机队伍。生成的编队会保存在列表中，可从中选择一支开始。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Receive a randomized team with a higher Cost allowance than Manual Team. Generated teams are saved to the list so you can choose which one to start with.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 使用随机编队刷新次数可生成新的编队。剩余刷新次数每日重置。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Use Randomized Team Reshuffles to generate new teams. Your remaining Reshuffles reset daily.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 若在结束图式构筑前抵达特定图式，将额外获得随机编队刷新次数。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: If you reach a certain Schema before ending a run, you'll earn additional Randomized Team Reshuffles.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 以随机编队开始时，额外获得图式构筑通行证经验。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Starting with a Randomized Team grants extra Schemacraft Pass EXP.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 探索图式
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Exploring Schemas

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 一局图式构筑由5个图式组成。击败各图式的头目即可前往下一个图式。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: A Schemacraft run spans 5 Schemas. Defeat each Schema's boss to advance to the next.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 表象是图式中可以移动到的地点，分为常规遭遇战、精锐遭遇战、头目遭遇战，以及喘息、诱惑、事件表象。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Representations are spaces you can move to within a Schema. They include Regular, Elite, and Boss Encounters, as well as Respite, Temptation, and Event Representations.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 骰子
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Dice

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 掷骰子后，掷出点数距离内的表象会显现出来。从中选择一个前往。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When you roll the dice, Representations within the rolled distance are revealed. Choose one of them to move to.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式扭曲
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Schema Deformation

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 用完剩余掷骰次数与额外掷骰后仍可继续掷骰子，但每多掷一次都会累积图式扭曲。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: You can keep rolling the dice after using all your remaining rolls and Bonus Rolls, but each additional roll adds Schema Deformation.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式扭曲会强化当前图式中的敌人。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Schema Deformation strengthens enemies in the current Schema.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 编队与构筑力
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Teams and Craftpower

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 编队中的所有人格共用同一人格等级。该等级会随战斗胜利而提升。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Every Identity on your team shares the same Identity Level. This level increases as you win battles.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 构筑力表示当前编队的强度。可在表象信息中与推荐构筑力进行比较。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Craftpower measures the strength of your current team. You can compare it with the Recommended Craftpower in Representation Info.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 表象信息
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Representation Info

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 可确认表象的类型、敌人的平均等级等信息。选择“进入”即可前往该表象。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Check the Representation type, the enemies' average level, and other details. Select "Enter" to move to that specific Representation.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 可出现卡包
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Available Packs

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 查看战斗胜利后可能作为奖励出现的卡包。选择卡包可查看其详细信息。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: See which Packs may appear as rewards for winning the battle. Select a Pack to view its details.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗编队
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Team Setup

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 决定参战的人格及其顺序。可出战人数会随图式推进而增加。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Choose which Identities to deploy and in what order. More deployment slots become available as you progress through the Schemas.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 超出出战人数上限的人格将成为候补人格。场上友方单位死亡时，候补人格会按编队顺序加入战斗。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Identities beyond the field deployment limit become Backup Identities. When a fielded ally dies, Backup Identities enter the battle in Deployment Order.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗准备
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Battle Preparation

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 通过画面下方的按钮可打开防御策略与简报。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Use the buttons at the bottom of the screen to open Defense Strat. and Briefing.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 准备就绪后，选择“开始战斗”即可开始。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When you're ready, select "To Battle!" to begin.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 防御策略
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Defense Strat.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 设定各人格使用守备技能的条件。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Set the conditions under which each Identity uses their Defense Skill.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 守备条件
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Defense Conditions

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 选择一名人格，然后从列表中选择条件。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Select an Identity, then choose a condition from the list.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 统一设置
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Set All Conditions

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 将编队中所有人格的条件一次性恢复为默认，或统一设为相同条件。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Reset all Identities on your team to their default conditions, or assign the same condition to all of them at once.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 简报
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Briefing

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 开始战斗前，可确认双方的平均等级、出现的敌人数量及其弱点。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Before starting the battle, check the average level of each side, how many enemies will appear, and what they're weak to.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: E.G.O资源
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: E.G.O Resources

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 比较首发出战人格的技能所能提供的E.G.O资源，与已装备E.G.O所需的资源。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Compare the E.G.O resources provided by the Skills of the Identities deployed first with the resources required by your equipped E.G.O.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 自动战斗
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Auto Battle

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 友方与敌方会根据各自的速度自动行动。双方技能相对时进行拼点。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Allies and enemies act automatically according to their Speed. When their Skills oppose each other, they Clash.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: TURN
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: TURN

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 画面中央的计量条显示回合进度。“回合结束时”效果会在每回合结束时触发。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: The gauge at the center of the screen tracks the turn's progress. Turn End effects activate at the end of each turn.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 参战人员
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Participants

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 出战的友方单位死亡时，由候补人格替补上场。编队中的人格全部死亡时，战斗失败。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When a deployed ally dies, a Backup Identity takes their place. If all Identities on your team die, you lose the battle.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 当前效果
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Active Effects

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 查看苦难与图式扭曲当前对敌人施加了哪些效果。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Check which effects from Obstacles and Schema Deformation are currently applied to enemies.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: E.G.O资源
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: E.G.O Resources

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗开始时，按罪孽属性计算(包括候补人格)，每有2个技能获得1个对应资源。战斗中也可根据所用技能的属性获得资源。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: At the start of battle, you gain 1 resource per 2 Skills of each Sin Affinity, counting Backup Identities as well. You can also gain resources during battle based on the Affinity of the Skills used.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 人格面板
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Identity Panels

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 画面下方的面板依次显示每名出战人格正在发动的技能、等待中的技能以及守备技能。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: At the bottom of the screen, each deployed Identity's panel shows their active Skill, queued Skills, and Defense Skill, in that order.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 使用E.G.O
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Using E.G.O

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: E.G.O资源充足时，在人格面板上选择E.G.O即可使用。目标会自动选定。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: If you have enough E.G.O resources, select an E.G.O on the Identity's panel to use it. The target is selected automatically.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 若要亲自选择目标，可将E.G.O向上拖动并放到敌人身上。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: To choose a target yourself, drag the E.G.O upward and drop it onto an enemy.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 将E.G.O向下拖动即可将其超频。松手即可使用，或将其放到敌人身上以选择目标。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Drag the E.G.O downward to Overclock it. Release to use it, or drop it onto an enemy to choose the target.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 长按E.G.O后松开，可查看其详细信息。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Press and hold the E.G.O, then release to view its details.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗报告
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Battle Report

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗报告会显示双方体力的变化、我方的平均理智值以及各罪人的战斗数据。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: The Battle Report shows how each side's HP changed, your team's average SP, and each Sinner's battle stats.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗结束后
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: After Battle

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗结束时，死亡的人格会归队，所有人格恢复至满体力。理智值会延续到下一场战斗，但低于0点的理智值会恢复至0点。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When a battle ends, Identities that died return and all Identities recover to full HP. SP carries over to the next battle, but any SP below 0 is restored to 0.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 重试
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Retry

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 每场战斗的重试次数有限。在没有剩余重试次数的情况下战败，图式构筑即告结束。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Each battle has a limited number of retries. If you lose with no retries remaining, your Schemacraft run ends.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗奖励：选择卡包
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Battle Reward: Choose a Pack

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 战斗胜利后，从提供的3个卡包中选择1个，然后从该卡包中选择人格与E.G.O。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: After winning a battle, choose 1 of the 3 Packs offered, then select Identities and E.G.O from that Pack.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 每个卡包会显示必定出现的所属阵营或关键词，以及各费用人格的出现概率。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Each Pack shows the guaranteed faction or keyword and the odds of drawing an Identity at each Cost.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 刷新卡包
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Reshuffling Pack

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 消耗刷新次数可替换提供的卡包。每连续替换一次，所需的刷新次数都会增加。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Spend Reshuffles to replace an offered Pack. Each successive replacement costs more Reshuffles.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 每次战斗胜利都可获得刷新次数，也可以从喘息表象等途径额外获得。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: You earn Reshuffles each time you win a battle. You can also get more from Respite Representations and other sources.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 选择人格与E.G.O
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Select Identities and E.G.O

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 打开卡包后，从提供的卡牌中选择规定数量的人格与E.G.O。可消耗刷新次数，将每张卡牌各重抽一次。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When you open a Pack, choose the specified number of Identities and E.G.O from the cards offered. You can spend Reshuffles to draw a replacement for each card once.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 编队 / 替换 / 碎片
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Team / Replace / Slivers

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 编队：为尚未编入队伍的罪人添加人格。若编队已满，需选择一名要移除的人格。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Team: Add an Identity for a Sinner who isn't already on the team. If the team is full, select an Identity to remove.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 替换：将罪人当前的人格替换为所选人格。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Replace: Swap a Sinner's current Identity for the selected Identity.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 碎片：不将人格编入队伍，改为获得该罪人的碎片。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Slivers: Receive that Sinner's Slivers instead of adding the Identity to the team.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 同步与碎片
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Uptie and Slivers

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 选择与编队中相同的人格时，其同步阶段提升。账号中未持有的人格最多只能提升至同步3阶段。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Selecting the same Identity you already have on your team raises its Uptie Tier. Identities you don't own on your account can only reach Uptie Tier 3.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 某名罪人的碎片收集足够后，其当前人格将提升至下一个同步阶段。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Once you collect enough Slivers for a Sinner, their current Identity advances to the next Uptie Tier.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 通用碎片
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Universal Sliver

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 人格已达同步上限的罪人，其碎片将转化为通用碎片。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Slivers for a Sinner whose Identity is already at its Uptie cap are converted to Universal Slivers.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: E.G.O异想解析
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: E.G.O Threadspin

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: E.G.O沿用账号中的异想解析阶段。未持有的E.G.O按异想解析1阶段计算。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: E.G.O use the Threadspin Tier on your account. E.G.O you don't own are set to Threadspin Tier 1.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 精锐遭遇战
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Elite Encounter

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在精锐遭遇战中获胜，除卡包奖励外，还可选择一项精锐奖励。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Winning an Elite Encounter lets you choose an Elite Reward in addition to your Pack reward.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 替换人格：将罪人当前的人格替换为提供的人格。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Replace Identity: Swap a Sinner's current Identity for the one offered.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 编入人格：将提供的人格加入编队。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Recruit Identity: Add the offered Identity to your team.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 强化：选择当前编队中的1名罪人，为其提供碎片。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Upgrade: Choose 1 Sinner on your current team and give them Slivers.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 放弃：不领取精锐奖励，继续前进。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Decline: Continue without claiming an Elite Reward.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 诱惑
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Temptation

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在诱惑表象中，会获得人格与E.G.O的提议。选择的人格将加入编队，或替换现有的人格。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: At Temptation Representations, you're offered Identities and E.G.O. An Identity you choose is either added to your team or replaces an existing Identity.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 也可以选择“放弃”，维持当前编队不变。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: You can also select "Decline" to keep your team as it is.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 部分提议会消耗掷骰次数。即使剩余次数不足也可以接受，但不足的部分会累积为等量的图式扭曲。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Some offers cost dice rolls. You can accept even if you don't have enough rolls left, but any shortfall adds that much Schema Deformation.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 事件
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Events

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在事件表象中，从给出的选项中选择一项即可获得对应效果。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: At Event Representations, choose one of the options presented to receive its effect.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 也可以不做选择直接离开。这样既不会获得任何效果，也不会承受任何苦难。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: You can also leave without choosing. You won't receive any effects or incur any Obstacles.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 苦难
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Obstacle

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 苦难会提升敌人的体力或敌人造成的伤害。苦难可叠加，并持续到本局图式构筑结束。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Obstacles increase enemy HP or the damage enemies deal. They stack and last until the end of the Schemacraft run.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 喘息
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Respite

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在喘息表象中，可从刷新次数、提升同步阶段、增加掷骰次数等效果中选择一项获得。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: At Respite Representations, you can choose one benefit, such as Reshuffles, a higher Uptie Tier, or additional dice rolls.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 使用通用碎片
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Using Universal Slivers

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 消耗通用碎片，可提升所选人格的同步阶段。以此方式可达到的最高阶段会随图式推进而提高。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Spend Universal Slivers to raise the Uptie Tier of an Identity of your choice. The highest Tier you can reach this way increases as you progress through the Schemas.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 最终战斗结果
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Final Battle Results

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式构筑结束后，可查看图式进度、进行的战斗场数、参战人格的伤害数据以及获得的奖励。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When your Schemacraft run ends, you can review your progress through the Schemas, how many battles you fought, the damage stats of participating Identities, and the rewards you earned.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 图式构筑通行证
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Schemacraft Pass

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 在图式中推进得越远，获得的通行证经验就越多。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: The farther you progress through the Schemas, the more Pass EXP you earn.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 通行证奖励只能在规定的领取期间内领取。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Pass rewards can only be claimed during the stated claim period.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 每周可获得的通行证经验有上限。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: There is a weekly limit on the Pass EXP you can earn.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 每周重置时，正在进行的图式构筑将会结束。请合理安排进度。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Any Schemacraft run in progress ends at the weekly reset. Plan your runs accordingly.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 达到当前开放的最高等级后，在开放更多等级前，将无法通过游玩获得通行证经验。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: When you reach the highest level currently available, you can no longer earn Pass EXP from playing until more levels unlock.

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 成就
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Achievements

_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.zh: 成就将在今后的更新中加入。
_tail/TutorialMainUIText.json#TutoSchema.en: Achievements will be added in a future update.

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_entra.zh:
要结束正在进行的图式构筑并重新开始吗？
选择“确认”后，将先根据当前的图式构筑进度发放奖励，再开始新的一局。
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_entra.en:
Forfeit the Schemacraft run in progress and start a new run?
Selecting "Confirm" will yield rewards based on your current Schemacraft progress first before the new run starts.

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_entra.zh: 本局随机编队刷新次数+{0}
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_entra.en: Reshuffle Random Team +{0} more times for this run

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 理智值恢复+{0}(进入房间时生效)
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: SP Healed +{0} (activates upon entering the room)

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 理智值损失风险-{0}(进入房间时生效)
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: SP Loss ={0} (activates upon entering the room)

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 描绘出本次图式构筑的尽头将会遭遇之物
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Schematize what is to be encountered at the end of this Schemacraft.

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 不做选择直接离开，则既不获得效果，也不承受苦难
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Leave without choosing to receive neither effects nor penalties

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 进入时，可选择获得人格或E.G.O(也可以都不选)。
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Upon entry, you may select an Identity or E.G.O to receive (you may also choose neither).

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 根据提议，编队中所有人格的理智值{0}
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Depending on the offer, SP {0} for all Identities in the team

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 进入后，从以下喘息效果中选择一项
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Upon entry, choose one of the Respite effects below

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 编队中1名人格同步+1阶段
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Uptie +1 for 1 Identity in the team

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 额外掷骰(未使用的额外掷骰将保留至下一个图式)
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Bonus Rolls (unused Bonus Rolls carry over to the next Schema)

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.zh: 进入后，将出现以下事件之一。选择其中一个选项即可获得对应效果
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_roomi.en: Upon entry, one of the events below appears. Choose one of its options to receive its effect

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_defen.zh: 防御
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_defen.en: Guard

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_defen.zh: 闪避
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_defen.en: Evade

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_defen.zh: 反击
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_defen.en: Counter

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_build.en:
Craftpower shows how well-developed your current team is.

Higher Identity Costs, Uptie Tiers, and levels increase Craftpower. Bringing Identities with the same keyword or faction and equipping higher-grade E.G.O also increase it. Fielded Identities contribute more than Backup Identities.

※ Craftpower is only a guide to your team's strength and has no direct effect on combat.

_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_ink_s.zh:
E.G.O资源不会延续到下一场战斗。每场战斗开始时，会根据当前编队获得E.G.O资源。

按属性计算，编队中所有人格(包括候补人格)该属性技能总数的一半(向下取整)即为该属性的资源获得量。
 · 技能1、技能2、技能3分别计为3个、2个、1个。
 · 守备技能不计入。
_tail/LimtochessUI.json#limtochess_ink_s.en:
E.G.O resources do not carry over between battles. At the start of each battle, you gain E.G.O resources based on your current team.

For each Affinity, you gain half the total Skill count of that Affinity across all Identities in your formation, including Backup Identities (rounded down).
 · Skill 1, Skill 2, and Skill 3 count as 3, 2, and 1, respectively.
 · Defense Skills do not count.
